examples.title: bee94890 (ego, kitchen task4): stir-fry a meat dish — 7 coarse steps, 46 fine hand-level narrations

timeline.text:
1. Put an appropriate amount of cooking oil in the pot and turn the pot to evenly distribute the oil.
2. Turn on the exhaust hood, pour in the chopped scallions, ginger, and garlic, stir-fry until fragrant.
3. Add the sliced ​​meat to the pot and stir-fry for a few seconds.
4. Add the fried eggs to the pot and stir-fry for a few seconds.
5. Add the wood ear fungus and mushrooms to the pot and stir-fry.
With the right hand, take the bowl with oil from the table and prepare to put it into the pot.
Right hand holding the bowl, pour a small amount of oil into the pot.
The right hand puts the bowl with all the oil poured out back onto the table.
Grip the pot handle with your right hand and gently shake the pot back and forth to evenly distribute the oil inside the pot.
Right hand presses the button to turn on the fire.
With the left hand, pick up the plate on the table. The plate contains onion, ginger, and garlic, ready to be stir-fried.
Left hand holding the plate Right hand using a wooden spatula to scoop the onions, ginger, and garlic from the plate into the pot.
The left hand puts the plate with chopped scallions, ginger, and garlic back on the table.
Right hand holds a wooden shovel and stir-fries in the pot.
The left hand picks up the plate of shredded meat and walks towards the wok.
With the left hand holding the plate, and the right hand using a wooden shovel to push the shredded meat from the plate into the pot.
Hold the wooden shovel with your right hand and stir-fry the shredded meat.
Put the plate back in its original place with your left hand.
With the right hand, continue to stir-fry in the pot using a wooden shovel.
Left hand picked up the plate with daylily buds and wood ear. Both hands held the plate and prepared to pour it into the pot.

With my left hand, I poured the daylily buds and wood ear mushrooms from the plate into the pot. With my right hand, I used a wooden spatula to scrape the daylily buds and wood ear mushrooms off the plate.
Place the plate back on the table with your right hand.
Use a wooden spatula in your right hand to stir-fry the daylily buds, wood ear mushrooms, and shredded meat in the pan.
Left hand picks up the bowl holding the eggs.
Then, the left hand poured the scrambled eggs in the bowl into the pot.
Put the bowl back with your left hand.
With the right hand holding a wooden spatula, continue stir-frying in the wok.
1. Add an appropriate amount of dark and light soy sauce to the pot.
Switching the shovel from the right hand to the left hand, the right hand picks up the soy sauce on the table.
Pour a small amount of soy sauce from the right hand into the pot.
Put the soy sauce back with your right hand.
Next, the right hand picked up the light soy sauce beside it.
The right hand holds the light soy sauce and pours a small amount into the pot.
Put the soy sauce back in its original place with your right hand.
1. Stir-fry over high heat until the vegetables are colored.
With the left hand holding the wooden spatula, it is exchanged to the right hand. The right hand uses the wooden spatula to continue stir-frying the vegetables in the wok.
1. Add an appropriate amount of salt to the pot.
Switching the wooden shovel from the right hand to the left hand, Using the right hand to take a spoonful of salt.
Use a spoon in your right hand to pour a spoonful of salt into the pot.
Put the spoon back into the salt jar with your right hand.
Switching the shovel from the left hand to the right hand, the right hand takes the shovel and continues stir-frying the vegetables in the pan.
1. Continue stir-frying until half-cooked.
Turning around, he put the shovel in his right hand into his left hand. He then scooped up a spoonful of salt with his right hand.
1. Add an appropriate amount of MSG to the pot.
With the right hand, scoop up a spoonful of salt. Pour the spoonful of salt into the vegetables in the pot.
Put the salt spoon back with your right hand.

1. Continue to stir-fry with a wooden shovel.
2. Cover the pan for a moment.
3. Open the lid and stir-fry for two more times.
4. Put the cooked dish into the plate.
5. Return the frying pan to its original position.
The wooden shovel in the left hand is exchanged for the right hand. The right hand holds the wooden shovel and keeps stirring the vegetables in the pan.
Switch the wooden shovel from your right hand to your left hand. Pick up the pot lid on the stove with your right hand.
Place the lid on the pot with your right hand.
After the vegetables are cooked, turn off the fire with your right hand.
Left hand exchanges with right hand, holding a shovel. At the same time, the right hand picks up the lid of the pot.
The right hand puts the pot lid on the stove.
Right hand holds a wooden spatula to stir-fry the cooked vegetables in the pot.
Lift the pot with your left hand,  hold the wooden spatula with your right hand,  and turn towards the table behind you.

With the left hand holding the pot and the right hand using a wooden spatula, The cooked vegetables are scooped into a plate one by one, Finally, the edges of the vegetables are pushed towards the center of the plate with the spatula.
With the left hand holding a pot,  the right hand places the shovel in the pot,  and then the left hand puts the pot back on the stove.
